description: Daily, weekly, monthly, annual XP quests and rank progression system.

anti_abuse.active_minutes: Count only active time with a reasonable cap per session.
anti_abuse.unique_views: The same title only counts once per period for unique title goals.
anti_abuse.actions: Actions must be genuinely performed and validated on the app.

daily.title: First Connection
daily.description: Open ManLore and stay active for at least 5 minutes.

daily.title: Extended Session
daily.description: Spend at least 10 minutes on ManLore.

daily.title: Long Session
daily.description: Spend at least 20 minutes on ManLore.

daily.title: Full Session
daily.description: Spend at least 30 minutes on ManLore.

daily.title: Editor
daily.description: Edit the title or details of a manga/comic.

daily.title: Clean Up
daily.description: Delete a title from your collection.

daily.title: Collector
daily.description: Add 1 new title to your collection.

daily.title: Explorer
daily.description: View 5 different titles.

daily.title: Curious
daily.description: View 10 different titles.

daily.title: Organizer
daily.description: Edit 3 titles.

daily.title: Archivist
daily.description: Add 3 titles to your collection.

daily.title: Big Clean Up
daily.description: Delete 3 titles from your collection.

daily.title: Perfect Mix
daily.description: Add, edit, and view at least one title.

daily.title: Daily Return
daily.description: Come back to ManLore after a previous day.

daily.title: Routine
daily.description: Perform 3 different interactions with the app.

daily.title: Active Library
daily.description: Interact with 5 titles in total.

daily.title: Apprentice Archivist
daily.description: Create or add 2 titles.

daily.title: Revision
daily.description: Edit 5 titles.

daily.title: Discovery
daily.description: View 15 different titles.

daily.title: Dedication
daily.description: Spend at least 45 minutes on ManLore.

weekly.title: Regular Visitor
weekly.description: Open ManLore on at least 3 days this week.

weekly.title: Frequent Reader
weekly.description: Open ManLore on at least 5 days this week.

weekly.title: Flawless Week
weekly.description: Open ManLore on all 7 days of the week.

weekly.title: Solid Habit
weekly.description: Perform at least 1 interaction every day for 7 days.

weekly.title: Versatile
weekly.description: Use at least 5 different action types.

monthly.title: Monthly Regular
monthly.description: Be active on at least 15 days this month.

monthly.title: Full Month
monthly.description: Be active on at least 25 days this month.

monthly.title: Loyalty
monthly.description: Be active on all 30 days of the month.

monthly.title: Polymath
monthly.description: Use at least 8 different action types this month.

annual.title: Century Year
annual.description: Be active on at least 100 days this year.

annual.title: Yearly Regular
annual.description: Be active on at least 200 days this year.

annual.title: Legendary Year
annual.description: Be active on at least 300 days this year.

annual.title: ManLore Devotee
annual.description: Be active on all 365 days of the year.

annual.title: 100-Hour Club
annual.description: Accumulate 100 hours of activity this year.

annual.title: Lore Scholar
annual.description: View 2,000 different titles throughout the year.

annual.title: Master of Constancy
annual.description: Achieve at least 30 completed daily streaks.

rank.title: Reach Rank C
rank.description: Advance from Rank D to Rank C.

rank.title: Reach Rank B
rank.description: Advance from Rank C to Rank B.

rank.title: Reach Rank A
rank.description: Advance from Rank B to Rank A.

rank.description: Advance from Rank A to Rank S.
